evals.prompt: Estou criando um projeto NestJS do zero com TypeORM e PostgreSQL. Preciso instalar e configurar o @multitechbr/nestjs-dynamic-query-builder pra usar filtros dinâmicos nos meus endpoints. Me ajuda a fazer o setup completo — .npmrc, main.ts, app.module.ts — tudo que precisa pra funcionar.
evals.expected_output: Complete setup with: .npmrc with GitLab registry, main.ts with extended query parser + ValidationPipe with enableImplicitConversion, app.module.ts with DynamicQueryBuilderModule.forRoot(). All three bootstrap steps present and correct.
expectations: Output includes .npmrc configuration with @multitechbr:registry pointing to gitlab.com
Output includes app.set('query parser', 'extended') in main.ts
Output includes ValidationPipe with transform: true and enableImplicitConversion: true
Output includes DynamicQueryBuilderModule.forRoot() in app.module.ts imports
Output imports from @multitechbr/nestjs-dynamic-query-builder correctly
Output does NOT skip any of the 3 mandatory bootstrap steps
Code examples are syntactically valid TypeScript

evals.prompt: Tenho uma entidade Product com campos: id, name, price, category, created_at, deleted_at. Preciso criar um endpoint GET /products que suporte filtrar por name (case-insensitive), price (range), category (múltiplos valores), ordenar por name e price, paginar, e excluir soft-deleted automaticamente. Usa o nestjs-dynamic-query-builder.
evals.expected_output: Controller with @ApiDynamicQuery having filters for name/price/category, sorts for name/price, and a service using queryBuilderService.execute() with customize callback for soft delete (deleted_at IS NULL). Uses ilike for name, between for price range, in for category.
expectations: Controller uses @ApiDynamicQuery decorator with filters array including name, price, category
Controller uses @QueryRules() parameter decorator paired with @Query() DynamicQueryDto
Sorts whitelist includes name and price (not created_at or deleted_at)
Service uses queryBuilderService.execute() with repository, query, and rules parameters
Customize callback adds andWhere for deleted_at IS NULL (soft delete filtering)
Does NOT expose deleted_at in filters whitelist (security)
Code mentions ilike for case-insensitive name search or documents operator usage

evals.prompt: Tenho entidades Order (id, status, total, created_at) com ManyToOne para Customer (id, name, email) e OneToMany para OrderItem (id, quantity, unit_price) que tem ManyToOne para Product (id, name). Preciso de um endpoint GET /orders que permita filtrar por status, customer.name (case-insensitive), incluir customer e items com items.product, e ordenar por created_at e total. Também preciso de field selection e que a resposta seja paginada.
evals.expected_output: Controller with @ApiDynamicQuery having nested filters (customer.name), includes for customer/items/items.product, fields selection, sorts. Service using execute(). Correct dot-notation for nested filtering with parent relation in includes.
expectations: Filters include 'status' and 'customer.name' with dot notation for nested field
Includes array has 'customer', 'items', 'items.product' for nested relationships
Fields array is defined and includes sort fields (created_at, total must be in fields)
Sorts array has 'created_at' and 'total' and both are also present in fields array
Uses @ApiDynamicQuery or @DynamicQuery decorator (not manual query building)
@QueryRules() is used to inject rules into the handler method
Service delegates to queryBuilderService.execute() with all parameters
